com.vector.cfg.gen.core.genusage.result.model

Interface IGenerationResultModel


  • @PublishedApi(value=ADDITIONS_ALLOWED)
 @PublishedApiDomain(value=AUTOMATION_IF)
public interface IGenerationResultModel
    IGenerationResultModel provides details of an executed or currently running generation process of the generator service. Clients can use the model to navigate through the result of a generation or updated e.g. a view during the running generation.

    All method parameters and return values must be non-null unless documented otherwise.
